text: Nice. ok so uh let me just ask you does this look correct? [Image #25] nothing has changed on the cube its just a normal cube still 16x16
resolution: Answered: the cube being a plain 16x16 cube is CORRECT — the UV atlas is derived FROM the mesh and an unedited cube's box-unwrap is exactly 6 flat 16x16 squares; the UV view does not (and should not) change the cube. The 33x50 u atlas + the 2x3 axis-tinted face layout + labels were all right. The ONE real bug: the per-face outline segments rendered as stray offset vertical lines because Seg positioned the rotated box by its start point with transformOrigin:'0% 50%', which the framework ignores (it rotates around the box center, like ViewCompass). Fixed Seg to center the box on the segment midpoint then rotate — so each face now traces a clean square outline in its axis color. UVPanel.tsx bundle-verified; hot-reload TSX. Nothing committed.
